verdict.rationale: Undermind is a hosted SaaS research platform, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions region selection or data residency. The only related item is the enterprise option to request complete removal of organization data, which is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
